description: React component for a persona builder app that enables uploading documents, editing persona info, and viewing final persona with various interactive states.

methods.name: validateFile
methods.description: Checks if the uploaded file has an allowed extension (.pdf, .docx, .txt).

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Handles files selected through file input, validating and adding them to the uploaded files state.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds a list of files to the uploaded files state after validation and limit checks.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles files dropped into the upload area, integrating with addFiles.

methods.name: handleDragOver
methods.description: Prevents default behavior for drag over events in upload area.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a file from uploaded files by id.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Initiates processing and transitions the app state to 'draft' after a simulated delay.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves user modifications to the persona, shows success message.

methods.name: handleFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes the persona, moving app to 'finalized' state.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a skill from the persona's skill list.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the persona's skill list.

methods.name: handleProfileImageChange
methods.description: Handles profile image upload and updates persona data.

methods.name: removeExperience
methods.description: Removes a work experience by id from the persona data.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns a string representing the file type based on extension.
